simple.meaning: מְסוּכָה (mᵉçûwkâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a hedge.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4534. mesukah מְסוּכָה noun feminine hedge (|| form of מְשֻׂכָה q. v. below שׂוך ); — only in figure מִמְּסוּכָה יָשָׁר Micah 7:4 , read מְס ׳יְשָׁרָם (|| כְּחֵדֶק טוֺבָם ), their most upright one is a hedge (an obstruction).

occurrences.englishText: The best of them is like a brier.
